$comment: Single source of truth for the Windows MIDI Services SERVICE PLUGINS version.
This is a SEPARATE release train from the App SDK (build/version.json), and uses the
same scheme. build-all.ps1 stamps this into build/staging/version/BundleInfo.wxi,
the version include used by the Transports installer (src/installers/plugins-installer).
1.0.1-preview.1. Bump 'patch' for each release; that is what distinguishes builds.
build:         4th field of the numeric bundle/file version only. It does NOT appear in
the SemVer string. CI can override with -BuildNumber <n> without touching
this file; -BumpBuildNumber increments and persists it.
NOTE: the Transports installer replaces the separate transport installers, the last of
which were 1.0.33-preview.8. Keep this version above theirs. An older installer with a
higher version counts as newer, and the Transports installer then refuses to install.
